assets.title: Limestone house — compressed runtime model
assets.author: The Season contributors
assets.changes: Original Blender house and 11 painted colour textures preserved. Added a subtle original procedural limestone normal map, then pruned, deduplicated, resampled and compressed geometry with meshopt; colour textures use ETC1S KTX2 and the normal map uses UASTC KTX2. Raw input retained in art/source/house-painted.glb.

assets.title: Qwantani (Pure Sky)
assets.author: Greg Zaal (original photography); Jarod Guest (sky edits)
assets.changes: Official 1K HDR converted with Babylon.js 9.30.0 into a 256px prefiltered cubemap: nine specular mip levels encoded as PNG RGBD, plus diffuse spherical polynomial data. No exposure, tint or rotation baked in. Raw HDR and conversion record retained under art/vendor/polyhaven/qwantani-puresky/.
assets.notes: The official asset and Poly Haven licence pages declare CC0. The direct HDR download supplied no separate licence file; License.txt retains that source declaration and the complete CC0 legal text.

assets.title: Low Poly Desert Buildings — retained CC0 sources
assets.author: Anker's Assets
assets.changes: Original FBX files retained unchanged. Four buildings, ladders and awnings are retextured, normalized to the established footprint and assembled into the shipped variants.

assets.title: Medieval Village MegaKit Standard — retained CC0 parts
assets.author: Quaternius
assets.changes: Original door and crate source meshes retained unchanged; used as retextured, resized parts in period-appropriate flat-roof houses and market porticoes.
assets.notes: The downloaded Standard archive explicitly declares CC0. Its unmodified License_Standard.txt controls this intake; the newer general QAL website notice is not used to license other archives. Source archive SHA-256 is recorded alongside the files.

assets.author: Katsukagi / 3dtextures.me

assets.notes: CC0 and redistribution declaration: https://3dtextures.me/about/ . Per-file download identifiers and hashes retained in source.json.

assets.title: Settlement architecture, stone bridge, timber dock and fishing boat
assets.author: The Season contributors (assembly and original geometry); Anker's Assets and Quaternius (CC0 model parts); Katsukagi (CC0 surfaces)
assets.changes: Six flat-roof variants assembled from the separately credited CC0 sources, including civic assembly halls and colonnades; original detailed portico, courtyard furnishings, bridge arches, timber docks and open fishing-boat hull. Geometry uses meshopt; all textures use shared KTX2 files with complete mip chains.
assets.notes: This entry identifies original assembly work, not a new licence grant. Embedded Anker, Quaternius and 3dtextures.me components remain CC0 under their individual source entries and retained declarations. Reproduction instructions and archive provenance: art/vendor/architecture/README.md.

assets.title: Shared architecture PBR surface maps
assets.author: Katsukagi / 3dtextures.me; The Season contributors (processing)
assets.changes: Plaster 002, Stylized Wood Planks 002 and Stylized Stone Wall 002 maps resized, tinted and encoded as ETC1S colour or UASTC data maps. Identical KTX2 payloads are shared by SHA-256 across all architecture models, preserving complete mip chains.
assets.notes: Original source maps and their exact download/source URLs are separately registered above. These files are required same-origin GLB dependencies; their content hashes and model references are recorded in art/source/architecture/runtime-manifest.json.
